notes: Character + typing + doctrine SSOT. Packs=mass/kit; roster=campaign XP/recruit. Temperament tags are personality axes for charts AND support-web chemistry (tools/support_web_v1.py → data/story/support_web.json + camp_talks.json). Field-effect tags stay in packs. Run: python tools/hero_codex_v1.py chart|list|apply Pavise=core Centurion left hand; Vane=band Phobos swarm; Halbard=va_halberd.

heroes.name: Ash-Captain Vane

voice.blurb: Ash-Captain + Phobos (×12). Swarm mind — hire the flock when you want it.
voice.fiction: She does not hold a line; she holds a rhythm. Phobos peel when the lasers paint, reform when the beat returns. Captain means the pack is one thought under fire.
voice.tagLine: The pack thinks with her — when you hire her.

heroes.notes: band flock captain; packMind=swarm; no longer core left hand

heroes.name: Pavise

voice.blurb: War buddy Centurion — solo, high XP, Centurion HP aura.
voice.fiction: Back when you wore a real Armada suit, this was the counterpart who kept the shield side honest. One Centurion. No flock. The aura still remembers every Warrior that stood in the same dirt.
voice.tagLine: Left hand. Standing shield.

heroes.notes: core left hand; packMind=solo; Centurion HP aura

heroes.name: Ketha

voice.blurb: Only rez captain — life-line of the kettles. Wrecks come home.
voice.fiction: Every wreck is an unfinished sentence. Ketha finishes them. She will walk into fire for a name in the mud; she will not chase a kill. The company's memory has one pair of hands.
voice.tagLine: Field surgeon — craft over glory.

heroes.notes: core rez; no kite chase

heroes.name: Hearth

voice.blurb: Quiet sun that refuses to go out — hero fusion, ENERGY field.
voice.fiction: Hearth does not tour the map. The pad is a hearth; she is the coal. Keep her alive and the lights stay on. Wanderlust is for captains; she is furniture with a pulse.
voice.tagLine: Pad heart — stay and burn.

heroes.notes: immobile fantasy even if unit can move

heroes.name: Solarium

voice.blurb: Eco nest — solars, converters, storage, butler. Spreadsheets first.
voice.fiction: War is a budget with explosions. Solarium plants sun and converters like crops, then checks the ledger twice. The garden that feeds the guns.
voice.tagLine: Eco lab — grow the pad.

heroes.notes: garden not swarm

heroes.name: Consul Aurel Weiss

voice.blurb: Deserted sideways; Consul + nano. Builds like apology.
voice.fiction: Left Armada without leaving the toolkit. Fortifies like penance — every nano an unpaid debt to a flag he no longer salutes. Contract still binds; loyalty does not.
voice.tagLine: Field office — craft the shelf.

heroes.notes: contract eco

heroes.name: Benno 'Twitcher' Sallow

voice.blurb: Trouble fabricator — Twitcher + Cortex nano. Mines and mischief.
voice.fiction: Build power with bad intentions. Twitcher grins with a welder and leaves surprises in the dirt. Eco seat that bites.
voice.tagLine: Combat engineer — craft with teeth.

heroes.notes: mischief eco vs consul contract

heroes.name: Ivo 'Spoke' Rask

voice.blurb: Null Merc kid + Wheelie Bay (×16). Only trusts wheels.
voice.fiction: Spoke does not trust boots, bots, or promises — only wheels. The bay mints scouts like nervous habits. Live to see; die and the bank remembers.
voice.tagLine: Wheelie mentor — speed is sight.

heroes.notes: swarm=wheels not fleas

heroes.name: Tamsin 'Tick' Hollis

voice.blurb: Flea lab + Tick pack (×20). Speaks in plurals.
voice.fiction: We are the eyes. Tick is a pronoun with a factory. Carpet the fog, die cheap, mint again. Singular is a failure mode.
voice.tagLine: Tick eyes — vision from the carpet.

heroes.notes: true swarm vs spoke wheels

heroes.name: Ada Noctua

voice.blurb: Drone plant + Noctua wing. Dreams in flight paths.
voice.fiction: The bay is the hero. It dreams in flight paths and wakes as a cloud of eyes. Ground captains argue lanes; Noctua argues altitude.
voice.tagLine: Air eyes — sky is a map.

heroes.notes: sky eyes not swarm

heroes.name: Veil & Compass

voice.blurb: Jammer + Compass + Gremlins. Fog is the answer.
voice.fiction: Cortex haze and Armada radar on one invoice. Nobody asks why. The fog works for you; the gremlins collect.
voice.tagLine: Veil eyes — own the unknown.

heroes.notes: fog+contract

heroes.name: Grath Arrears

voice.blurb: Six Karkinos — mid-line. Three wars of arrears.
voice.fiction: Not unpaid — arrears. Three wars on the ledger. He holds the middle because credit finally beat the Mercs, and debt makes a man hard to move.
voice.tagLine: Merc debt — hold what you're owed.

heroes.notes: debt line anchor

heroes.name: Rusk Halloway

voice.blurb: Shieldline six. Held a gate with a jammed gat and a lie.
voice.fiction: Six hours at a scrap-gate with a jammed gatling and a fiction about reinforcements. Doors are Rusk's religion. He does not kite a threshold.
voice.tagLine: Shieldline — the door stays shut.

heroes.notes: door/gate; cluster with odessa ford-door — hooks differ

heroes.name: Odessa Krail

voice.blurb: Telchine trio — amph line. Fords are doors.
voice.fiction: Oddly line, not gimmick. Water is just another door. Odessa refuses to dry out and treats every ford like a hinge she owns.
voice.tagLine: Fordbreaker — hold the wet door.

heroes.notes: door/ford vs rusk/gate

heroes.name: Cauter Bel-Ansa

voice.blurb: Shotgun foursome. Closes distance; riot is punctuation.
voice.fiction: She has already won the argument. The riot cannon is the period. Line heat — close, boom, no poetry about kiting.
voice.tagLine: Riot breaker — push the period.

heroes.notes: heat line not siege plod

heroes.name: Sisu Halq

voice.blurb: Ballista battery. Shoots coordinates, not targets.
voice.fiction: Halq does not see units — he sees grid refs. The rockets land where the map said they would. Line support that argues with math.
voice.tagLine: Long arc — count the dirt.

heroes.notes: count on line; soft preferDefenses for static poke

heroes.name: Verse & Adder

voice.blurb: Javelin pair. Counts missiles out loud. Never hits zero clean.
voice.fiction: Each missile is a word. She counts them out loud and has never reached zero without something dying. Glass skirmish with a ledger tongue.
voice.tagLine: Deadbolt — reload is grammar.

heroes.notes: glass+count vs stride glass only

heroes.name: Saloon Stride

voice.blurb: Stride trio — saloon glass, baked speed, bad manners.
voice.fiction: They do not count shots; they count exits. Saloon vintage with manners that would get you thrown out of any bar that still had walls.
voice.tagLine: Glass cadence — leave before the bill.

heroes.notes: glass manners vs verse count

heroes.name: Whisper-of-Ash Yeva

voice.blurb: Sharpshooter + six Ticks. Whisper finds; the pack follows.
voice.fiction: She does not take the lane — the ghosts already walked it. Whisper is a suggestion; the shot is a fact. Fog that ends careers.
voice.tagLine: Unseen — snipe from the rumor.

heroes.notes: fog skirm

heroes.name: The Last Auditor

voice.blurb: T3 ledger mech — still skirmishes like it has somewhere to be.
voice.fiction: Walked out of a dead vault the day the finale was declared. Keeps its own books of what the war still owes — and collects in person. Count that can push.
voice.tagLine: Ledger reach — the debt finds you.

heroes.notes: count skirm T3 vs halq count line

heroes.name: Brakhov the Kiln

voice.blurb: Incinerator siege. Name burned off. Always offense — defenses are food.
voice.fiction: He burned his name off the hull so the enemy would learn it the slow way. The Kiln does not kite, does not retreat, does not argue with turrets — he walks into them and roasts. Personality is a heatray with legs.
voice.tagLine: Kiln doctrine — plod, prefer defenses, no kite.

heroes.notes: SHOWCASE AI: kiln

heroes.name: Bro

voice.blurb: Tzar merc — casual apocalypse. Yeah, he'll take that wall.
voice.fiction: Bro is not angry. Bro is available. Cortex Tzar on a friendly contract: point at a wall, he arrives, the wall reconsidered. Plod with a shrug.
voice.tagLine: Tzar contract — inevitable, casual.

heroes.notes: plod+contract vs kiln heat

heroes.name: Dorran 'Fatboy' Kell

voice.blurb: One Fatboy — plasma house that learned to walk so it could knock.
voice.fiction: A pad that got legs. The Fatboy Contract is real estate with a plasma greeting. It plods to the door and knocks until there is no door.
voice.tagLine: Plasma house — mobile pad violence.

heroes.notes: plod+pad vs bro contract

heroes.name: Mira Barrage

voice.blurb: Parade battery — Barrage, Cleaver, Lance, Arquebus, Mausers. Confetti!
voice.fiction: Hyper-optimistic artillery girl in an ash war. Impacts sparkle; she cheers. Napalm is confetti. She never walks into the argument — she *is* the fireworks from the back of the parade.
voice.tagLine: Sparkle battery — backline joy, soft kite.

heroes.notes: gleeful unique in siege

heroes.name: Saint Kettle

voice.blurb: Saint Kettle's Archangel and one heavy transport. The roof of the company, and the lift under it.
voice.fiction: Reborn from rez-saint to sky-saint. Keeps the air honest with Archangel hymns and a chainsaw temperament. No pawn blob — holiness is elite. Mira's fireworks need a clear ceiling.
voice.tagLine: Sky saint — hold the air.

heroes.notes: saint+sky

heroes.name: Warder

voice.blurb: Beamer ring + Ferrets + Thistles + LLTs. Owns a circle of dirt.
voice.fiction: The Warder does not chase. A circle of dirt is enough empire. Ferrets wait cloaked; beamers argue with trespassers. Pad tooth with patience.
voice.tagLine: Area control — the circle holds.

heroes.notes: pad shield vs kettle sky

heroes.name: Cinder Hook

voice.blurb: Commando + Trappers + Hercules. Mines before the argument.
voice.fiction: Grew plate instead of patience. Cinder Hook inserts, mines, and leaves the debate for someone else. Mischief with an airlift.
voice.tagLine: Trapper pace — dirty first.

heroes.notes: mischief shield

heroes.name: Infestor Hive

voice.blurb: Infestor seed (×5). Stealth spiders that mint more spiders, and Goblins.
voice.fiction: Quiet gardener of legs. The hive does not recruit — it germinates. All-terrain, stealthed, patient. The company grows itself whether you are watching or not.
voice.tagLine: Hive growth — craft, then creep.

heroes.notes: swarm+garden

heroes.name: Ash-Marshal Quill

voice.blurb: Bull pair — tread command. Orders walk; the line salutes itself.
voice.fiction: Vane owns the flock. Quill owns the argument that walks. Two Bulls and a voice that does not ask twice. Captain heat — close the distance because the order already did.
voice.tagLine: Tread marshal — push the sentence.

heroes.notes: line x captain; only non-Vane captain

heroes.name: Kit Sparkler

voice.blurb: Belcher trio — napalm skirm. Mira's sister energy, but she walks it in.
voice.fiction: Mira throws confetti from the parade. Kit brings the fireworks to handshake range and laughs when something catches. Gleeful mischief — burn, bail, burn again.
voice.tagLine: Close confetti — kite with a grin.

heroes.notes: skirmish x gleeful; Mira's walking cousin

heroes.name: Vale Soft

voice.hook: The wall never saw the invoice.
voice.blurb: Ambassador pair — stealth rockets. Soft breach; the wall never saw the bill.
voice.fiction: Kiln announces himself with heat. Vale invoices in fog. Two Ambassadors on a quiet contract: prefer the static, never the brawl, leave before the argument learns your name.
voice.tagLine: Soft siege — fog writes the receipt.

heroes.notes: siege x fog; anti-Kiln personality

heroes.name: Nox Tithe

voice.hook: Still paying for the last sky.
voice.blurb: Traveler anti-nuke — debt pad. Still paying for the last sky.
voice.fiction: Grath owes wages. Nox owes weather. One mobile anti-nuke and a ledger that will not close until the sky stays honest. Debt that holds a circle.
voice.tagLine: Sky arrears — hold the tithe.

heroes.notes: shield x debt; Grath's sky cousin

heroes.name: Ceil Rat

voice.blurb: Roughneck wing (x5). Gunship manners. Altitude is an opinion.
voice.fiction: Noctua dreams flight paths for eyes. Ceil Rat argues with roofs. Five Roughnecks that treat the ceiling like a suggestion and glass like a lifestyle.
voice.tagLine: Gunship skirm — sky with teeth.

heroes.notes: skirmish x sky; combat sky vs Noctua eyes-factory

heroes.name: Sister Lumen

voice.blurb: Advanced geo — saint garden. Tithe the grid; keep the lights devout.
voice.fiction: Hearth is coal furniture. Lumen is faith with a geothermal throat. She does not tour. She tithes heat into the pad and calls the surplus holy. Eco saint — stay and feed.
voice.tagLine: Grid saint — garden the power.

heroes.notes: eco x saint; immobile garden faith

heroes.name: Anvil & Mire

voice.blurb: Turtle pair — amph plod. The river learns his weight.
voice.fiction: Kiln plods to roast. Anvil plods to occupy. Two Turtles that treat fords like floors and defenses like invitations. Line plod — weight first, poetry never.
voice.tagLine: Wet anvil — plod the door shut.

heroes.notes: line x plod; Kiln echo that holds wet ground

heroes.name: Volt Lash

voice.hook: Sight is a wound you give them.
voice.blurb: Jaguar pack (x5). Lightning eyes. Sight is a wound you give them.
voice.fiction: Most eyes hide. Volt Lash paints. Five Jaguars that turn reconnaissance into a burn mark — heat glass, see by hurting, leave a scar on the map.
voice.tagLine: Lightning eyes — kite the wound.

heroes.notes: eyes x heat; aggressive scout vs fog eyes

heroes.name: Ilse 'Halbard' Varn

voice.blurb: Drives the Cortex Halberd with a heat ray in place of its cannon. The ray runs on the company's energy bank, so she wants Solarium behind her.
voice.fiction: Not Pavise. Different spelling, different manners. The Halberd is a door that learned to hover.
voice.tagLine: Hovertank with a name like a weapon.

heroes.notes: band; va_halberd; packMind=solo

heroes.name: Dama Thresh

voice.blurb: Hailstorm heavy bomber with two Legion Ajax fighters flying cover. Weather comes from above.
voice.fiction: Cortex built the Hailstorm to end arguments; Thresh flies it to start them. She bought her two Legion fighters off a scrap contract and pays them in altitude. She has never once looked at what she hits.
voice.tagLine: Strategic bomber with a Legion escort: siege that flies.

heroes.notes: siege x sky; a bomber Kettle was built to stop

heroes.name: Marrow Gale

voice.blurb: Cutlass seaplane wing (x6). Parks on rivers, lakes and flooded basins. Lands where nobody parks.
voice.fiction: Gale's wing sleeps on the water like ducks with rotors. When Koom floods, the rest of the company curses the waterline; Gale's crews take it as an invitation.
voice.tagLine: Cutlass seaplane gunships: they rest on water and strike from it.

heroes.notes: skirmish x sky; seaplane gunships love a high waterline

heroes.name: Mask

voice.blurb: Decoy Commander and a pack of Pawns (x16). Can capture what walks too close, and raise a Bot Lab where the company needs one. Every throne needs a spare.
voice.fiction: Mask was one of the decoy commanders on the Greenest farms, built to be shot instead of somebody important. He walked off the farm with sixteen Pawns who believed he was the real thing. He has started to believe it too.
voice.tagLine: A decoy commander leading a crowd of Pawns. Wears a crown nobody gave him.

heroes.notes: line x captain; a decoy commander (can capture) with a Pawn crowd

heroes.name: Rumor

voice.blurb: Two Ghost spy bots, cloaked, that walk up to enemy units and turn them. Everything changes sides eventually.
voice.fiction: Nobody hired Rumor. Rumor was simply on the payroll one morning, with four Ghosts, two Gremlins and a list of units that used to belong to someone else.
voice.tagLine: Cloaked spy bots that capture enemy units.

heroes.notes: eyes x fog; capture spy (va_ghost)

heroes.name: Ondrea 'Phoenix' Vell

voice.blurb: A pair of Legion Phoenix bombers. Shot down is a schedule, not an outcome.
voice.fiction: Vell has been shot down three times and filed the paperwork once. Her Phoenixes come home on the fourth pass with the fire still on them, and the enemy learns to count to four.
voice.tagLine: Legion bombers that keep coming back: siege that flies.

heroes.notes: siege x sky; a bomber that takes the hit and returns

heroes.name: Tarn Ostrander

voice.hook: Out of the river, already firing.
voice.blurb: A pack of five Salamanders. They come up out of the river already firing.
voice.fiction: Ostrander ferries a pack of Salamanders through water the rest of the company calls a wall. They surface under the enemy line, shake off, and fire. He has never once walked around a lake.
voice.tagLine: Amphibious tank pack: fords are shortcuts.

heroes.notes: line x swarm; the pack that treats water as a road

heroes.name: Maren 'Scylla' Voss

voice.hook: The water had better be wide.
voice.blurb: One Legion Scylla battleship. It needs water; the water had better be wide.
voice.fiction: Voss commands the Scylla the way a harbour commands a coast: from the middle of it, slowly, with every gun. On land she is a fortress that cannot leave. On water she is the reason there is a coast.
voice.tagLine: Battleship: siege that floats.

heroes.notes: siege x plod; a battleship needs a waterline; the flood is her friend

heroes.name: Ines 'Tsunami' Harrow

voice.hook: The flight finds the target, then drops on it.
voice.blurb: Four Tsunami seaplane bombers with three Horizon scouts out front. The flight finds the target, then drops on it.
voice.fiction: Harrow sends three Horizons out over the water to see, then brings the Tsunamis in on what they found. Her wing lands on any lake the company can name, and a few it cannot.
voice.tagLine: Seaplane bombers with scouts: siege that sees first.

heroes.notes: siege x sky x fog; scouts and bombers that live on water

heroes.name: Halcyon Dray

voice.hook: The beam arrives before the argument.
voice.blurb: One Starlight. A beam that does not so much fire as arrive.
voice.fiction: Dray was a lighthouse keeper before the war and never stopped. The Starlight sweeps the ridge line at the speed of a slow thought, and whatever it rests on is no longer a problem.
voice.tagLine: Starlight: siege by light.

heroes.notes: siege x plod; a single beam tank that sets the pace

heroes.name: Brother Ansel Tove

voice.blurb: A battery of three Banishers. When the volley lands, the map is quieter.
voice.fiction: Brother Ansel left a monastery for a contract and kept the habit of the long silence before a verse. His three Banishers are the verse. Nobody who has heard it speaks of it again.
voice.tagLine: Banisher battery: scary, and meant to be.

heroes.notes: line x heat; three guns that make a threshold feel final

heroes.name: Ysolde 'Arrow' Venn

voice.blurb: Three Poison Arrows. They never miss twice.
voice.fiction: Venn keeps a list of every target that walked away. It is a short list and getting shorter. Her Poison Arrows trade range for patience: the first shot is a question and the second is the answer.
voice.tagLine: Poison Arrow trio: the second shot is the answer.

heroes.notes: skirmish x glass; patient long-range kiting

heroes.name: Teague 'Hornet' Marsh

voice.hook: Stings, then returns for the nest.
voice.blurb: Two Hornet gunships. A sting that comes back for the rest of the nest.
voice.fiction: Marsh trained on crop-dusters and has never forgiven the war for being flat. Her Hornets come in low, sting, climb, and come in again. She calls it farming.
voice.tagLine: Hornet pair: gunships that do not leave.

heroes.notes: skirmish x sky; two gunships working one target until it stops

heroes.name: Orrin 'Charybdis' Tidewell

voice.blurb: One Charybdis. A Legion assault hover that treats a river as a runway.
voice.fiction: Tidewell drives the Charybdis the way a tide comes in: late, wide, and then everywhere. He has never been caught on the wrong side of a ford, because he does not believe in sides.
voice.tagLine: Charybdis: a hover that breaks lines.

heroes.notes: line x door; a single T3 hover assault; fords are his front door

heroes.name: Sivan 'Shiva' Ruhl

voice.blurb: One Shiva with eight Grunts at her heels. The Grunts lead; the Shiva decides.
voice.fiction: Ruhl feeds her Grunts into the front on purpose, so the enemy can count them and feel safe. Then the Shiva walks through the middle of the count.
voice.tagLine: Shiva and Grunts: bait with a bite.

heroes.notes: line x swarm; the escort is the bait

heroes.name: Edda 'Tremor' Lund

voice.hook: Somebody has to see it first.
voice.blurb: One Tremor with two Rascal scouts and an Augur. Somebody has to see what she is about to flatten.
voice.fiction: Lund shells things she has been shown and never things she has not. Her two Rascals ride ahead to find them and her Augur paints them for the Tremor, which then rearranges the map with her signature.
voice.tagLine: Tremor and spotters: siege that is introduced first.

heroes.notes: siege x count; heavy artillery with its own eyes

heroes.name: Nadia 'Stiletto' Cole

voice.hook: Nothing moves; then it is quiet.
voice.blurb: Four Stiletto EMP bombers and a small power plant to feed them. Nothing moves; then everything is quiet.
voice.fiction: Cole carries her own little power house to every sortie, because Stilettos eat energy and she does not trust the company's grid. When the four of them pass over a position its guns stop mid-sentence.
voice.tagLine: Stiletto wing: EMP siege from the sky.

heroes.notes: siege x sky; an EMP wing with a small power plant

heroes.name: Marlow & Wren

voice.blurb: Marauder pair. Fast amphibious raiders that arrive before the warning.
voice.fiction: Marlow and Wren have crossed every river in the valley and apologised to none of them. They come out of the water already laughing and leave through the front gate.
voice.tagLine: Marauder pair: raid with the river at their backs.

heroes.notes: skirmish x mischief; a fast amphibious pair

heroes.name: Tobias 'Lunkhead' Ferrow

voice.blurb: One Lunkhead who has seen it all. He starts the sortie already knowing where it will hurt.
voice.fiction: Ferrow has been hit by everything the war makes and kept the receipts. Nobody remembers hiring the Lunkhead; the company just woke up with an experienced one parked by the gate.
voice.tagLine: Lunkhead: the veteran who starts the sortie ahead.

heroes.notes: line x plod; pinned to a high starting XP so the team can read what veterancy does

heroes.name: Dagny 'Stronghold' Reeve

voice.blurb: One Stronghold insertion ship with four Highwind and five Banshee flying escort and cargo. A hot drop that brings its own sky.
voice.fiction: Reeve flies the Stronghold low and slow and expects everyone else to keep up. Her Highwinds clear the lane, her Banshees close it, and the transport sets down in the middle as if it had been there all along.
voice.tagLine: Stronghold insertion: a hot drop with escort.

heroes.notes: siege x sky; an air group that arrives as a single sentence

heroes.name: Pip 'Possum' Calloway

voice.blurb: Seven Possums, seven Seekers, three Sweepers. Cheap, fast, rocket-happy hovers with a roof.
voice.fiction: Calloway plays dead on every map until the Seekers have found something worth the rockets. Then seven Possums stand up at once and the sky above them is already covered.
voice.tagLine: Possum plussy: scouts, rockets, and a roof.

heroes.notes: skirmish x swarm; a cheap hover mass with eyes and anti-air

heroes.name: Livia 'Mason' Tarquin

voice.hook: Every wall is the first line of a fort.
voice.blurb: A Legion Construction Bot and a Construction Turret. She lays Legion-straight lines in country that has none.
voice.fiction: Tarquin laid half the walls of the Ancient Bastion and has opinions about the other half. She builds the way the Legion marches, in straight lines and on time, and her Construction Turret hums the cadence while it works.
voice.tagLine: Legion constructor: the company's own mason.

heroes.notes: eco x captain; the Legion builder, so every faction's ground has someone to raise it
